scope: Host-only planner A/B, native selection workspace reuse, and a projection of previously measured complete-CSA preparation/execution; no new multilayer model benchmark

software.cudnn_frontend_version_scope: Wheel metadata; imported source identified by native_source_commit

host_benchmark.scope: CPU planner only; no GPU timings

host_benchmark_protocol.topology: consecutive ranks grouped by eight; CPU validation only for CP16/CP64
host_benchmark_protocol.max_rows_per_rank: twice the largest block-balanced source shard

amortization.formula: step_ms + prepare_ms / reuse_count, independently for each policy
amortization.assumption: All metadata/workspace preparation is shared and each compatible layer has the measured cost; layer-dependent activations and selected IDs are not shared
